## Goal
The value-only path (a person who wants only a phone number or an email address removed, `Profile.value_only`, `models.py:372-374`) changes how the exposure scan chooses sites and URLs (`scan_brokers`, `_main_urls`, `engine/exposure.py:396-425`) and how matching works (`score_lookup`, `engine/matcher.py:293-310`). `tests/test_bl_in_08_exposure.py` covers the main flow; check it first and add only gaps. Tests only; any defect is a finding with file:line and a strict xfail.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. A phone-only person with a registry where no broker has `phone_search_url_pattern`: the scan completes, `coverage.sites_total == 0`, band `not_checked`, and the headline says no sites could be searched (`exposure_score.headline`); no network is touched.
2. An email-only person never gets a name search URL, an old-address or previous-name extra page (`old_address_url`/`previous_name_url` return None for value-only people), and never a phone URL.
3. Lookup hits are always POSSIBLE and never CONFIRMED by the matcher (Rule 7, `matcher.py:49-50`), for a page that shows only the person's number and for one that shows several numbers including theirs; a page whose numbers are all someone else's is NO_MATCH and produces no review to-do.
4. A hit with the person's email in different case and with surrounding spaces still matches (`matcher.score_value`, `matcher.py:285-286`); a plus-address of the same mailbox does NOT match (documented current behaviour).
5. Two people (one full, one phone-only) in the same store do not affect each other's listings or to-dos.
6. The score for a value-only person counts a possible lookup hit as uncertain (`coverage.uncertain`), not as a found listing.
7. A person who switches from phone-only to full removal in the same store gets name searches on the next scan, with no leftover value listings treated as confirmed.
8. Sockets blocked; fake fetcher and fake registry; `tmp_path` only.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
